entry_type.description: Which entries make the agent start when one is published.

agent.description: The agent that does the job (Settings → AI → Agents). Its permissions must let it save drafts: set Entries: author to Allow for it.

message.description: The job, in a sentence or two. The entry's title and link are added for you, and so is the reminder to write the text itself and save it with create_draft rather than compose_entry (Playbooks only reach the agent's own writing).
message.example: Draft a Bluesky post and a Mastodon post announcing it, each as its own draft.

playbooks.description: Published Playbooks to load in full for this job, on top of the agent's own (up to 3). Leave empty for none.
